programmes.title: Legends & Lies: The Real West
programmes.desc: Fox News mainstay Bill O'Reilly jumps behind the camera, serving as executive producer of this series that explores stories behind some of the most famous -- and infamous -- figures of the Old West. Each episode delves into the life of one such individual, using new interviews, archival photos and forensic science to paint a complete picture of the person. Direct descendants and historians are among the interviewees who shed light on the lives of such figures as Jesse James, Davy Crockett, Doc Holliday and "Wild" Bill Hickok. The 10-episode series is a companion to O'Reilly's book of the same name.

A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programmes.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler

When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programmes.title: Camera Girl

But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programmes.title: The Offer
programmes.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programmes.title: Blood in the Comments
programmes.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programmes.title: The Other Sister

Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

Now, Tony faces a stark choice: witness or prison.

programmes.desc: A thousand years old Chinese flamethrower, will it be a real weapon or just a kitchen tool for flaming.

programmes.desc: LISA pathfinder, has led the way for a space-based gravity wave detector, what are gravity waves and why are they so hard to detect?

programmes.title: The New Frontier S3 - "Interface"
programmes.desc: The Ionosphere is little understood, it effects radio communications, GPS signals and satellites alike, it changes between day and night and is influenced from space and from Earth, new satellites have been launched to study this zone.

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Thunder Down Under"
programmes.desc: In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Hawaii"
programmes.desc: We have filmed extensively in Hawaii, filming big-wave surfing at the famous Banzai Pipeline on Oahu’s North Shore, and filming George surfing with the “Hawaian Fire” firefighters. We have also filmed at the Hawaii Tsunami Institute and in Hilo.

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Italia Wild"
programmes.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programmes.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Tornadoes"
programmes.desc: Explore with us the most destructive tornadoes in history, why could no one predict it?

programmes.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "Wales"

programmes.title: Supersonic: The Great Adventure
programmes.desc: The epic story of 70 years of supersonic innovation, from Chuck Yeager's breakthrough to the future of flight.

programmes.title: Disruptive Behaviour

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Carbon Sinking"
programmes.desc: Massive sargassum blooms are choking beaches, but a Scottish company plans to sink the seaweed to trap carbon and tackle climate change.

programmes.desc: Neil Cairns visits physicist Carlo Rovelli in Verona to explore time, black holes, and the mysteries of quantum physics.

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Cooling Cities"
programmes.desc: Reya El-Salahi meets Alexander Valentino, who plans to use Naples’ ancient canals and aqueducts to cool the city in summer.

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "DNA Archaeology"
programmes.desc: Neil Cairns visits archaeologists and geneticists who traced a 20,000-year-old deer tooth pendant to a Stone Age woman.

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Saving the Iberian Lynx"
programmes.desc: Reya El-Salahi visits Spain’s Sierra Morena to see how conservation brought the Iberian lynx back from under 100 to thriving again.

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Imaging the Aurora"
programmes.desc: Reya El-Salahi explores how the northern lights can disrupt technology and visits EISCAT 3D, a new radar studying solar particle impacts.

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Long COVID"

programmes.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Rewilding Bison"
programmes.desc: Emma Keeling treks through Romania’s Tarcu Mountains to see how European bison, once extinct in the wild, are making a comeback.

programmes.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Food"

programmes.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Transport"

programmes.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Sport"

programmes.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Apparel"

programmes.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Healthcare"

programmes.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Communications"
programmes.desc: The New York City Marathon highlights our connected world, driven by 62-metal smartphones, microscopic microchips, and billion-dollar cloud bunkers.

programmes.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Notre Dame"

programmes.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Angkor Wat"
programmes.desc: Temples, designed to honor the Gods, have been at the heart of cities since the earliest times

programmes.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Power Of Water"

programmes.desc: As far back as the Bronze Age, humans were building ships capable of crossing oceans and trading between continents.

programmes.episode: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programmes.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programmes.title: What's in the Barn
programmes.episode: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programmes.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programmes.episode: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programmes.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programmes.title: Caffeine & Octane
programmes.episode: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programmes.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R.  The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programmes.title: Caffeine & Octane

Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna
